sourceFile: 笔译参考书1-《理解当代中国 核心术语学习手册》.pdf
notes: 来源为扫描件 Windows OCR（仅中文引擎），按页面顺序、页内自上而下只抽取「中文典故 + 项目符号英文译法」；中文出处解释（出自…／意为…）与成段英文解释一律不收，页眉、页码不收。cn 已删除 OCR 在汉字间插入的空格，中文标点（顿号、逗号、句号、引号、书名号）保留原样，条目原文末尾的句号未删。[订正登记：页码 原样 → 订正（依据）] [p135] the optimal use ofwords. → the optimal use of words.（英文单词间漏空格）。[p136] AII things have a beginning → All things have a beginning（AII 为 All 的 l→I 字形混淆）；the foundation Of a state → the foundation of a state（句中小写被误识为大写 Of，依据英文大小写规范）。[p137] hiS → his（2 处）、aS → as（1 处）、ti mes → times（单词被拆）（依据：小写被识为大写、拆词还原）；忏 you can em ploy → If you can employ（忏 系 If 误识，依据同一条引文的 p138 英文作 'lf you can employ the strength of the people，且本句下文紧接 if you can employ the wisdom；em ploy 为拆词）；strength Of the people／wisdom Of the people → of（2 处 Of→of）。[p138] Agriculture is the foundation Of a country → of（Of→of）；Attaching importance tO agricultural development → to（tO→to）。[p139] tovalue amity and friendship with neig hbors → to value amity and friendship with neighbors（tovalue 漏空格、neig hbors 拆词，依据固定译法 neighbor）；tO pursue amity and good neig h borliness → to pursue amity and good neighborliness（tO→to、拆词还原）。[p140] One studies everything tO obtain knowledge → to（tO→to）；Limits lead tO changes; changes lead tO solutions; solutions lead tO development. → to（3 处 tO→to）。[p141] tO seek common ground while shelving differences → to（tO→to）；tO expand common ground whileshelving differences → to expand common ground while shelving differences（tO→to、whileshelving 漏空格）。[p142] Utilized with restraint, resources will be abundant; otherwise, they will be scarce. 与 OCR 一致，无订正。[其他存疑／判断说明] 存疑（归类）：p140「穷则变，变则通，通则久。」的第三条英文行 When things reach their extreme, change occurs. After the change they evolve smoothly, and thus they continue for a long time. 在 OCR 中无项目符号，且位于「出自《周易·系辞下》」之前；判断为原书给出的第三种译法（与 p139「亲仁善邻」多条项目符号译法同式），故按译法收录；p141 英文解释首段（This notion comes from The Book of Changes. …）与该句逐字重复，未重复收录——如需从严，可把该行视为英文解释首段而从 en 中删除。p140 Extreme-Change-Continuity 系原书带项目符号的短语式译法，照收未改写。页眉判断：p136／p138／p142 页眉 OCR 为「第 三 部 分」，p140 更误作「第 三 昌 阝 分」，与本部分奇数页页眉「用 典 阐 释」不同；因内容与前后页首尾相接（p135 末句 …shows strength ， 与 p136 首句 morahty, and warmth… 同属一句，p137→p138、p139→p140、p141→p142 同理），判定仍属第三部分「用典阐释」，未越界、未提前停止，仅在此登记。未发现「中文典故 ↔ 英文译法」配不上的情况（0 处配对存疑）。

en: Writing is about expressing ideas through the optimal use of words.
After making a good start, we should ensure that the cause achieves fruition.
All things have a beginning, but few can reach the end.
The people are the foundation of a state.

entries.cn: 明者因时而变，知者随世而制。
en: A smart man changes his approach as circumstances change; a wise person alters his means as times evolve.

entries.cn: 能用众力，则无敌于天下矣；能用众智，则无畏于圣人矣。
en: If you can employ the strength of the people, you will be invincible under heaven; if you can employ the wisdom of the people, no sage will be cleverer than you.
Agriculture is the foundation of a country and the top priority in governance.
Attaching importance to agricultural development is the fundamental plan of the country.
to value amity and friendship with neighbors
to be benevolent and friendly toward neighboring countries/states
to pursue amity and good neighborliness

entries.cn: 穷理以致其知，反躬以践其实。
en: One studies everything to obtain knowledge, and proves it in practice.
Limits lead to changes; changes lead to solutions; solutions lead to development.
When things reach their extreme, change occurs. After the change they evolve smoothly, and thus they continue for a long time.
to seek common ground while shelving differences
to expand common ground while shelving differences

entries.cn: 取之有制、用之有节则裕，取之无制、用之不节则乏。
en: Utilized with restraint, resources will be abundant; otherwise, they will be scarce.
